items.summary: The Express security team is pausing from December 18, 2026 to January 4, 2027, alongside the OpenJS Foundation CNA.
items.title: Express is joining the OpenJS CNA end-of-year break

items.summary: Express's router now publishes a TracingChannel for every middleware, route handler, and param callback, so you can observe Express without patching it.
items.title: Express is now observable by design

items.summary: Security releases for body-parser and multer have been published. We recommend that all users upgrade as soon as possible.
items.title: October 2026 Security Releases

items.summary: A vulnerability in Express body-parser middleware enables a malicious client to crash a server with a single request.
items.title: CVE-2026-111181: Denial of service in body-parser
body-parser vulnerable to Denial of Service via trailing bytes after a compressed request body
